message:
{
  "verdict": "escalate",
  "summary": "The run clip stays in place and its planted feet hold, but skin stretch fails at 7.73 against a limit of 1.0; the stretched edges are hidden inside the tunic, so the images can't show whether the defect is visible, and changing the animation library would not fix it.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "check": "motion",
      "severity": "major",
      "observation": "Skin stretch reaches 7.73 against a limit of 1.0. At t=0.60 s the worst edges stretch to 8.7 times their bind length, and the 12 worst range from 2.3 to 8.7. In both the front and back views they sit inside the tunic skirt: at the crotch between the legs (trouser and inner skirt edges on RightUpperLeg) and at the inner hem just above the knees and boot tops. The stretch plot stays between 3.5 and 8 on every frame, not in a single spike. This matches the skin weighting in that region (the skirt_reweight grading from Hips to the thighs, or the crotch weights) pulling apart as the legs scissor. The clip itself is not the cause.",
      "evidence": "assertion 'skin stretch (edge length vs bind pose)' 7.732 > 1.0; assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/04_stretch_detail.png; 03_plots.png (bottom-right edge stretch curve)"
    },
    {
      "check": "motion",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The frame strip shows no torn or spiking geometry from the outside. The tunic hem and the trousers read cleanly in every side and 3/4 frame, so the stretch is hidden under the skirt at gameplay distance. It could still show on a low camera angle or when the legs cross at mid-stride (frames 9/14 and 10/14, t=0.62 s to 0.69 s).",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/01_frame_strip.png"
    }
  ],
  "escalation_reason": "The only failing assertion is skin stretch, and it comes from the skin weights at the crotch and inner skirt (the skirt_reweight region of the clean stage), not from the run clip. Changing the animation library, which is the only revise action available for motion, would not fix it. The frame strip doesn't show the defect from outside, so the images can't tell whether it is visible in play. The user needs to decide between two paths. One is to fix the weights, either the skirt_reweight grading or the crotch weighting on RightUpperLeg. The other is to accept the stretch as hidden inner geometry and record it in docs/decisions.md.",
  "questions_answered": [
    "The body stays in place. Hips travel at most 0.033 m and end at 0.0 m. The onion skin stays centred on the origin post, and the top view shows no drift, fling or slide.",
    "Yes. The foot speed for each planted foot drops near zero during its contact window (left around 0.03 to 0.13 s, right around 0.53 to 0.63 s; p90 0.345 m/s, under the 0.5 limit). The root holds a flat 5.0 m/s, which matches the gameplay speed.",
    "No broken poses. The arms swing forward and back at the sides with none behind the back, no limbs pass through the body, and no joints are twisted or collapsed. No stretched skin shows from outside, but the stretch detail image shows stretched edges hidden under the tunic at the crotch and the inner hem.",
    "Three pass: root travel 0.033 m against 0.15, foot slide 0.345 m/s against 0.5, and bind deviation 1.206 m against 1.8. Skin stretch fails at 7.732 against 1.0. The stretch detail image places the failing edges inside the tunic, at the crotch and the inner hem on RightUpperLeg, which points to the skirt and crotch skin weights rather than the clip."
  ],
  "images_seen": [
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/01_frame_strip.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/02_onion_skin.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/03_plots.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/motion_player/judge/motion-run-1/04_stretch_detail.png"
  ]
}
